title: RetrievalResult
description: L2 contract. retrieve(query, as_of, view, k) -> [Candidate]. Retrieval is pluggable (vector / lexical / graph / whatever) but every backend must obey two rules: it must respect the as_of point (never return facts that were not yet valid, or that have since been superseded, unless as_of says otherwise), and it must report what it excluded — the no-silent-caps rule (principle 12: the kernel protects trust, recall is a separate, honestly-measured budget).

retrieval_id.description: Unique identifier for this retrieval call.

query.description: The query that was retrieved against.

as_of.description: The point in time this retrieval is scoped to. 'Current' is just as_of(now).

view.description: Name of the projection view queried, matching a projection.view_name.

results.description: Candidates actually returned, at most k.

excluded.description: What was left out and why, e.g. below score threshold, outside as_of window, backend truncation. Required even when empty, so an empty list is a positive claim of completeness rather than an unreported gap.

event_id.description: The log event this candidate is grounded in.

excerpt.description: Optional human-readable excerpt of the candidate content.

reason.description: Why these candidates were excluded, e.g. 'outside_as_of_window', 'below_score_threshold', 'backend_truncated_at_k'.

count.description: How many candidates this exclusion reason applied to.
